title: ‘When prevention disappears, infections rise’: can the world still end AIDS?
title_zh: ‘预防消失，感染激增’：世界还能终结艾滋病吗？
abstract: The United Nations’ deadline for eliminating HIV/AIDS as a public-health threat is unlikely to be met. But medical, political and social advances have raised hopes that longer-term success is still possible.
abstract_zh: 联合国消除艾滋病毒/艾滋病作为公共卫生威胁的最后期限不太可能实现。然而，医学、政治和社会进步提升了人们对长期成功仍有可能的希望。
snippet: The United Nations’ deadline for eliminating HIV/AIDS as a public-health threat is unlikely to be met. But medical, political and social advances have raised hopes that longer-term success is still possible.
